 Product Details 

Part Code:H6242Y2.5G100

*   BASEC Approved
*   Plain annealed copper conductor
*   PVC insulated
*   PVC sheathed
*   Operating temperature: -15°C to 70°C
*   Min bending radius: 6 x Ø

Designed for use in light industrial and domestic wiring. These cables are intended for fixed installation in dry or damp premises. These cables can be installed in conduit, in cable trunking and in cable ducting. Or where there is deemed little risk of mechanical damage these cables can be clipped direct, on cable tray, embedded or in free air. These cables are not intended to be laid underground.
